text: DAX intelligence for Power BI (design ready: docs/design-docs/dax-intelligence-design.md). Approved scope (operator 2026-07-05): (C1) safe hand-written DAX reference extractor in crates/powerbi-tmdl-parser (extract_dax_references producing columns/bracket_refs/functions; string+comment-aware lexer; stable seam for a future tree-sitter swap); (C2) DAX lint: Tier 1 syntactic via "engram verify <model.tmdl>" gate + Tier 2 semantic (broken/unqualified/qualified refs, measure cycles) via a new lint_dax MCP tool; add VerifyFinding.severity; (C3) extend impact_analysis to span Power BI nodes (resolve powerbi_node by name; traverse existing powerbi_edge BFS for column -> measure -> visual/report blast radius; additive powerbi_neighborhood + root_kind). Data-model: add PowerBiColumn.expression; emit pbi_uses_field measure->column/measure edges; new find_powerbi_nodes_by_name query. 6-phase plan: P1 extractor -> P2 carry column DAX -> P3 ref edges -> {P4 impact span, P5 lint tier1} -> P6 lint tier2+tool. No CozoDB schema change (powerbi_node/edge exist; BFS already traverses powerbi_edge). Supersedes tree-sitter-from-scratch (no grammar exists; see docs/decisions/2026-07-05-dax-parsing-approach-spike.md). Open Qs: lint_dax standalone vs unified; reuse pbi_uses_field vs new pbi_depends_on_measure; code<->PBI bridge deferred.

Full CLI <-> MCP parity: the MCP tool surface (src/tools/mod.rs dispatch) and the CLI command service (src/cli/commands/, src/bin/engram.rs) MUST mirror each other in functionality AND documentation, and ship a complete MCP-to-CLI command mapping doc. Current state (2026-07-05): substantial parity already exists and CLI --help annotates each subcommand with the MCP tool it mirrors (bind=set_workspace, daemon-status=get_daemon_status, workspace-status=get_workspace_status, flush=flush_state, sync=sync_workspace, index=index_workspace, search=unified_search, query-memory=query_memory, symbols=list_symbols, map-code=map_code, impact=impact_analysis, query-graph=query_graph, stats=get_workspace_statistics, health=get_health_report, branch-metrics=get_branch_metrics, report token-savings/eval/retry-metrics=get_token_savings_report/get_evaluation_report/get_mutable_script_retry_metrics). GAPS to close (MCP tools with no CLI subcommand): query_graph_neighborhood, create_task, update_task, query_changes (git-graph), index_git_history (git-graph), and the planned lint_dax (B0E2B374). Also verify reverse direction (every CLI subcommand maps to an MCP tool) and that verify/manifest local-only commands are documented as such. Deliverables: (1) close functional gaps so every agent-facing MCP tool has an equivalent engram <cmd> subcommand and vice versa (respecting daemon-vs-direct/local distinctions); (2) a canonical, maintained mapping doc (table: MCP tool | CLI command | daemon/local | notes) under docs/ and referenced from both surfaces; (3) doc parity: CLI subcommand help references its MCP tool (already a convention) AND MCP tool docs/catalog reference the CLI command; (4) a parity guard test/contract that fails when a new MCP tool is added without a CLI mapping (and vice versa) to prevent drift. Grounding: src/tools/mod.rs (dispatch + should_record_metrics), src/shim/tools_catalog.rs (compile-time catalog / manifest), src/cli/commands/*.rs, src/bin/engram.rs (subcommand help already annotates MCP names).

Rec1 (engram graph quality): call-edge recall is file-local only. code_graph.rs resolves ExtractedEdge::Calls against per-file function_ids, so ALL cross-file calls are dropped; parsing/rust.rs resolve_call_name drops field_expression (method/receiver calls like state.foo()). Result: functions that call cross-file or via methods (e.g. get_daemon_status, get_workspace_status) have ZERO outgoing call edges -> map_code/impact_analysis blast-radius is unreliable. Fix is architectural (workspace-global name resolution + method extraction) with precision/recall tradeoffs (name-only resolution creates ambiguous/false edges) and org-wide blast radius. STASHED for operator input. See docs/decisions/2026-07-08-callgraph-cross-file-resolution-deliberation.md for full design + recommended bounded approach (deferred post-pass + unambiguous-name guard, mirroring existing reresolve_references_edges pattern).
